Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Johnson Charles and Alick Athanaze to open for the Windies. Junaid Siddique to bowl first.
...THE CHASE...

For West Indies, it was the spinners who did the job. Kevin Sinclair and Yannic Cariah were absolutely brilliant. Once they got the ball to turn, they wrecked havoc. Kevin Sinclair was the pick with a two-fer but he was well-supported by Yannic Cariah who has had an excellent series. Windies now will be very confident of chasing this down and making it 3-0. United Arab Emirates need to bowl out of their skins if they are to win this one. Can they defend this? We will find out in a bit.

That escalated quickly! Let me remind you, United Arab Emirates were 142 for 2 and from there, they have been bowled out for 184! The likes of Vriitya Aravind, Muhammad Waseem and Rameez Shahzad sewt the platform for a big score but once Vriitya Aravind fell, it was a procession. They kept losing wickets. Just the one batter managed to score above 10 from the middle and the lower order and United Arab Emirates have been bowled out for a very low score. They will be extremely disappointed. They looked all set for something around 300 but they have fallen well short.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! That is the end of the innings. Kevin Sinclair has 4. Shorter and outside off, Ali Naseer looks to cut, this is a little too full to play that shot. It goes off the inside edge and it is taken by the keeper. United Arab Emirates ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 184!

TOSS - United Arab Emirates have won the toss and ELECTED TO BAT!

Two games so far in this series and both have been won by the Windies. They have sealed the series with a game to go and now will be looking to inflict the whitewash. UAE on the other hand, have been beaten quite easily in this series so far but they will hope to put up a fight and end the series with a win. They though will have to play really well if they are to do so. Can they do so?
